payload.description: Join Wendy Martin, national award-winning science teacher, to guide you through a virtual reality cat dissection in Mammalian Organ Pack Dissection. Learn the fundamentals of the feline anatomy through its various systems in our fully immersive VR experience.

22.7°C VR is an interactive audio and visual journey that invites you to (re)discover the polar world.
Guided by sound, you'll navigate an ‘outer’ dimension imbued with powerful, majestic and dangerous nature, before discovering an ‘inner’ dimension in which you'll find yourself in touch with yourself, your sensations and your fears. These two dimensions gradually merge until you reach a state of harmony and communion with the universe.

¡Zombies! put you in the middle of the action as you try to escape the unstable zombie world. Players must use a combination of wits and skill to get to the heliport and certain escape. The only problem is, the zombies are everywhere, they appear to be very hungry and very still. There is a limited amount of time within which the player can escape.
Think about Sudoku, but reinvented!

A late night drive.  The law is watching.
You are being followed through dangerous, dark roads on a horrifying drive... to hell.

Controller-free gameplay, use your hands to steer, shift and change the  radio.

Gather your friends and play this party, funny, fast paced game in order to see who is better at throwing stuff, eating, drinking or other common activities when the time is your worst enemy! To complete each task you have a maximum of... yeah... you guessed it... 10 seconds!
Dive into an adrenaline-fueled challenge where every second counts! You have just 17 seconds to eliminate every enemy in the scene.

시간을 거슬러 1943년으로 회귀해, VR로 클래식 아케이드 도그파이트의 재미를 즐기세요

클래식 에센스 / VR 기술
거대한 3D 양자 시뮬레이터 화면 앞에 앉아서, 안전벨트를 매고 전설적인 세로 스크롤 타이틀의 마법에 빠져 보세요.
1인칭 관점을 "클래식" 시점으로 대체하고, 엄청난 기동을 적의 탄환을 회피하세요. 눈 앞에 펼쳐지는 역동적인 시나리오 요소를 마음껏 감상하세요. 역대급으로 실제적이고 빠르게 진행되는 시뮬레이션입니다. 

특징:
- 유머로 가득한 16개의 스토리 모드 레벨.
- 24개 몰입 존.
- 64개 미션.
- 200개 이상의 항공기 업그레이드.
- 튜토리얼이나 코인 투입 없는, 끝없는 액션; 무한 재시도 가능.
VR로 즐기는 최고의 숫자 연결 챌린지! 육각형 타일을 연결하여 더 높은 숫자에 도달하는 중독성 강한 3D 퍼즐 게임입니다.

Welcome to Widewater! 2LIT is an open-world action driving experience set in the sun-soaked, neon-charged city of Widewater. Cruise the streets, hit the water, take to the skies, and step into a world of speed, style, chaos, and freedom.

2MD is a groundbreaking motion-controlled arcade football game. Draw the plays and throw, hand-off, or run the ball before the clock runs out!

‣ Throw like a pro in a seated, standing, or room-scale, experience.
‣ Draw unique offensive plays.
‣ Play 2-minute drill or 20, 40, or 60 minute games.
‣ 56 Customizable teams, 8 leagues and body types
‣ Incredible presentation, achievements, leaderboards, a virtual trophy case, & more.
‣ Become the ball-carrier and catch with manual receiver mode.

Run, dodge, and cling to a spinning log in 360 Tree Runner! Play as a brave male cat racing through a wild forest log. Avoid deadly branches, rotate 360°, and stick to the log with perfect balance using your left and right triggers. Survive the twisting path to reunite with your beloved at the finish line. Are you fast and agile enough to complete the challenge?

This is the VR implementation of the classic Mahjong game
Creative design of solid 3D mahjong levels and simple game rules!
5 relaxing environments, 8 various colourful tile sets,60 levels and night mode! Mixed Reality support
Explore photoreal 3D-scanned environments in VR. Walk around with teleport locomotion, take in the details, and discover real-world spaces like never before.

payload.name: 4X4 드라이빙 시뮬레이터
payload.description: 4X4 Driving Simulator에서 강력한 차량을 조종하세요! 깊은 진흙, 바위길, 가파른 산길로 가득한 험난한 환경을 정복하세요. 사실적인 차량 물리 엔진, 몰입감 넘치는 1인칭 플레이, 흥미진진한 미션으로 도전적인 오프로드 주행을 마스터하세요. Meta Quest를 위해 제작된 스릴 넘치는 오프로드 모험을 경험하세요!

Welcome to the Christmas 2025 Multiplayer Version of The Game!

- No Micro Transactions, nor Pay to Win.
- Create your Avatars, modify your Cue and Style. 
- 110,000 Active Users <3 Thank you for Support!
- Free Trial Play is here, along with new difficulty levels and an Auto Matchmaking System.

Play now the most realistic VR 8 ball pool game! Engage in thrilling matches against AI opponents or connect with friends around the world for a real-time pool face-off.

Wear the headset and Come to the 9 ball pool club to improve your snooker techniques. Whether you sit or stand, you can play this billiard game. This pool game allows players to play 9 ball pool using the teleport option if they feel motion sickness. The player will play against an AI in this offline snooker game.

You're a black dog! While playing video games, your hooman best friend has been thrown at the top of the weirdest tower there is! Your goal is simple: get to the top of the tower to save your friend. But it's not going to be easy!

rows.source_name: A Boy A Shield And A Sword
rows.parsed_name: A Boy A Shield And A Sword

payload.description:
A Boy A Shield And A Sword is a high paced, color slashing adventure.

Trapped in a childhood dream, use your shield and your sword in creative ways and overcome your nightmares.
Climb climb climb! Get your pick axes and use them to climb as fast as possible on top of the mountain. How fast can you go?!

payload.name: 피셔맨즈 테일
payload.description: 2019년 올해의 게임(Game of the Year) VR 어워드를 수상한 게임에서 현실을 이리저리 구부리고 비틀어 보세요. 단순한 말장난이 아니예요. 피셔맨즈 테일은 정말 모든 것이 뒤집히고 돌아간, 정신을 구부리는 VR 퍼즐 어드벤처입니다.

다수의 게임상을 수상한 A Fisherman's Tale의 후속작 A Fisherman's Tale 2에서 새롭고 놀라운 모험을 떠나보세요. 새롭고 정신을 쏙 빼놓는 VR 퍼즐 메커니즘을 체험하며 서정적인 이야기에 푹 빠져들게 됩니다. 내 몸을 사용해 퍼즐을 풀고 팔다리를 분리하기도 하며 새로운 부품을 찾아 이용하기도 합니다. A Fisherman's Tale 제작진이 생명을 불어넣은 아름답고 독특한 장소들을 여행하며 진실을 밝혀내 보세요. 마음을 사로잡을 이 게임만의 독특한 VR 체험이 여러분을 기다립니다.

rows.source_name: A frog that swallowed a ring
rows.parsed_name: A frog that swallowed a ring

payload.description:
Cut open a frog's stomach in virtual reality to learn the names and descriptions of all of its organs 
and descriptions of all the frog's organs and learn about their structure and roles.

Guide Guinevere on a quest to save the kingdom from darkness. Find mysterious objects in a living labyrinth board to solve unique puzzles and defeat the evil Mordred, all from the comfort of your grandmother’s attic.

이 게임에서 플레이어는 소녀를 안내하고, 다양한 사고로부터 보호하고, 꿈 같은 세상을 모험합니다.

아름다운 하늘 풍경을 배경으로 소녀와 함께 수많은 도전을 극복합니다.

소녀가 하늘의 위험, 예를 들어 땅의 큰 융기와 강풍에 날리는 장애물을 피하도록 도와야 합니다.

소녀의 길을 가로막는 캐릭터도 매우 독특하며 다양한 표정을 보여줍니다.

숨겨진 아이템을 수집하고 특별한 이벤트를 경험하세요.

Escape Rooms and Physics Puzzles with mixed-reality elements and lots of balls.

It was your only way off this forsaken planet, but standing aboard a colossal stolen mech, you find yourself surrounded by unfamiliar buttons, levers, and monitors. In full VR, push, pull, press and hack everything you can find in an attempt to activate this lumbering beast and make your escape.

Join the space pack and embark on a high-stakes cosmic adventure: Battle meteor storms, rival feline-astronauts, and chaotic mishaps like sneezing fits and questionable chicken sabotage. Solve puzzles, play rhythm mini-games, and explore newly discovered planets!!
You are the first human to travel to the edge of a black hole without a return ticket, in this little space adventure you will face situations and dangers that no one has ever seen before.

AAA Driver provides a realistic driving experience with a variety of vehicles.

1. Free driving practice in various environments
2. Racing mode
3. Various driving physics simulations
4. Parking skills

Meet the amazing graphics!

AAA Sailor allows you to drive a variety of boats, yachts, and ships, and provides a realistic experience.

1. Boat racing function
2. Free boat driving practice
3. Submarine driving, torpedo launching function
4. Aircraft carrier driving and air fighter driving
5. Medieval warship driving and cannon operation
6. Various fish fishing
7. Rowing, sailing and lowering

Advanced graphic technology is applied to maximize the realistic feeling.

A race of spaceships in a gravitational tube in the middle of the sidereal vacuum.

payload.name: 앱스트랙트 슈터: VR 어드벤처
payload.description: 빛나는 액션의 세계로 들어서세요!
You take on the role of a prisoner who has recently awoken from cryosleep on a faraway planet. In exchange for a reduced sentence, you must check human research stations that have gone silent.

Accounting+ is a NIGHTMARE ADVENTURE COMEDY by Crows Crows Crows, designed with Squanch Games. Over double the size of the original (critically, critically acclaimed) Accounting. Experience classic reality gameplay: clean up your office, take the battery out of the cooling machine, play the skeleton xylophone, and/or summon thousands upon thousands of demons.

rows.source_name: Acetone Evaporation Experiment - ContentsDa Science Experiment
rows.parsed_name: Acetone Evaporation Experiment - ContentsDa Science Experiment

payload.description: Experience the fascinating process of evaporation with the acetone evaporation experiment. It's a simple yet intriguing demonstration of how substances change from liquid to gas, providing a clear insight into the principles of physical changes and vapor pressure.

rows.source_name: Acid Base Indicator Experiment - ContentsDa Science Experiment
rows.parsed_name: Acid Base Indicator Experiment - ContentsDa Science Experiment

payload.description: Dive into the colorful world of acids and bases. This experiment uses natural indicators to reveal the pH levels of various substances, showcasing the fascinating changes in color that occur when acids and bases interact.

경고: 모바일 기기로 플레이하는 다른 사람 최소 한 명과 함께 플레이해야 하는 매우 중독적인 VR 게임입니다. iOS 및 Android용 필수 모바일 게임은 무료입니다.

Resolution Games에서 제작한 이 미친 멀티플레이어 게임에서 황금 도토리를 지켜내실 수 있나요, 아니면 다람쥐처럼 달아나시겠어요?

Across the Valley - portable Edition

Across the Valley is your friendly VR farm where you really lend a hand. Instead of clicking around in menus, you care for the animals and plants with your own hands.

Sow, water, weed and harvest your own plants, raise adorable baby animals, milk the cows, shear the sheep and go on a truffle hunt or simply enjoy the hand-drawn graphics and cozy music while relaxing on your farm.
폭발적인 세트 피스와 영화 같은 디자인을 갖춘 블록버스터 VR FPS인 Action Hero에서 공룡의 얼굴을 때리고, 산탄총으로 닌자와 싸우고, 질주하는 기차에서 악당을 추적하세요. 게임플레이는 느린 동작으로 진행되며 플레이어가 움직일수록 속도가 빨라집니다. 스타일리시한 만족감으로 총알 주위에 기대고, 공중에서 무기를 잡고, 거대한 보스를 처치하세요.
Action Resort는 4-in-1 최고 평점 스포츠/액션 게임입니다. 준비되셨나요?
Bring the simple pleasure of frying eggs to life in VR. Pour oil, crack eggs, season with salt, and flip to perfection. Sharpen your cooking skills with engaging, repeat practice sessions.

Step into virtual reality and create a cozy cup of hot chocolate using rich milk, luscious chocolate, and just the right amount of sugar. Perfect your skills with fun, repetitive practice designed to make you a hot chocolate master!

Dive into a refreshing VR treat by crafting your own ice bars. Fill molds with fresh strawberries, pour creamy milk, and freeze them to perfection. Hone your ice bar making skills through immersive, hands-on practice.

Savor the classic Korean street snack in VR by skewering rice cakes and sausages, frying them to a crisp, and drizzling flavorful sauce on top. Build your expertise and enjoy the process with repetitive hands-on training.

Craft your own delicious mushroom pizza bread in virtual reality. Layer fresh ingredients on bread, cook it in a hot pan, and savor the magic of creating your perfect pizza. Practice makes perfect, and this content helps you get there fast!

Cook up a comforting bowl of ramen in VR. Open the packet, add the ingredients to the pot, and carefully boil to deliciousness. Build your confidence and cooking skill through immersive, repeat practice.

Experience the art of fresh spring roll making in VR. Julienne vibrant veggies, place them on delicate rice paper, and roll to perfection. Develop your skills through interactive, repetitive practice designed for fun and mastery.

The handmade hamburger-making content lets you create a hamburger in virtual reality. Grill the patty, prepare the ingredients, and assemble the burger. Designed to improve your skills through repeated practice, it allows you to master hamburger-making.

Kimchi stew content lets you cook kimchi stew directly in virtual reality. After cutting the kimchi into appropriate sizes, place it in a pot, add tuna, pour in water, and bring it to a boil. It is designed to allow you to practice cooking kimchi stew repeatedly to master the skill and improve your abilities.

The rice cooking content allows you to cook rice directly in virtual reality. Pour an appropriate amount of rice, rinse it with water, then add water until it reaches the level where it ripples on the back of your hand. Place the inner pot into the electric rice cooker and press the cook button. It is designed to allow you to practice rice cooking repeatedly to master it and improve your skills.
Learn how to use an Automated External Defibrillator (AED). This life-saving skill is essential in emergency situations where someone is experiencing cardiac arrest.
Protect massive transport ships during dangerous slingshot maneuver. Man your station, load missiles, and fight off waves of outlaw attackers in retro-futuristic space combat. Every shot counts.

AEROES: Beat the Rush는 아케이드, 피트니스, 리듬 게임의 장점을 결합했습니다. 혼합 현실(MR)에서만 가능한 독특한 게임플레이 메커니즘으로 방 전체를 뛰어다니게 됩니다.

경로를 그려 비행 우주선을 착륙시키고 크레딧을 획득하세요. 충돌을 막고 위험을 피해 점점 더 어려워지는 웨이브에서 살아남으세요 - 각 웨이브는 이전보다 더 격렬해집니다.

AEROES: Beat the Rush에 대한 플레이어들의 반응:
"이 게임은 MR에서 특별한 무언가가 있다"
"...Beat Saber보다 더 땀나게 만든다"

Glide and surf through handcrafted tracks at breakneck speed. Fly close to obstacles to charge up your boost meter, then time it just right when you engage your boost for max speed. Chase your best times, race against other players' ghosts, and climb global leaderboards in a high speed journey of control and flow.

payload.name: 어펙티드 대저택
payload.description: 많은 사랑을 받았던 저주의 집 VR 게임을 이제 Quest에서 즐기실 수 있습니다. 새로운 게임 모드인 건틀릿도 포함되어 있습니다!

The only way to understand Urban Storytelling it's by experiencing it! 
Choose which film director you would like to be and experience urban 
Africa with your crew. This is your assignment, and this is how you are 
going to understand what it means to be an African Space Maker, a 
real urban hero!!

AFROROUTES is a musical VR documentary - a journey through different Afro-communities and slave descendants around the world. A simple and intuitive designed VR experience, transporting the user to unexpected places with amazing characters and outstanding music. An immersive journey through the diverse slavery roads, documenting and exploring today's afrocultures, rites and traditions worldwide - created by  Selim Harbi and Sönke Kirchhof, produced by INVR.SPACE.

A short, emotional VR experience set at a fragile moment between an ending and a beginning.
Without direct narration or dialogue, players are drawn into a symbolic journey through time, memory, and self-reflection.
This is not a traditional game, but a contemplative VR experience.
VR을 위해 하나부터 열까지 만들어진 After the Fall은 궁극의 멀티플레이 좀비 아포칼립스입니다! 최대 3명의 동료 생존자와 함께 팀을 꾸려서, 지옥처럼 얼어붙어 뒤틀려버린 적대적인 세계에 맞서세요.
Survive in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies and mutants while awaiting rescue… Can you endure in the Dead Zones?

👑 왕국은 저절로 지어지지 않습니다!
🏰 VR을 위해 만들어진 중세 도시건설 게임 — 두 손으로 직접 지으세요.

농장, 선술집, 병영까지 하나하나 직접 배치하세요. 🌾 밀은 빵으로, 홉은 맥주로. 👥 주민들을 배부르고 일하게, 그리고 행복하게. ⚔️ 그런 다음 군대를 훈련시키고, 습격이 오면 성벽을 지켜내세요.

습격과 습격 사이, 당신만의 속도로 지으세요 — 또는 왕국을 한계까지 밀어붙이세요. 왕이 될 수 있겠습니까? 👑

Through a succession of time jumps from the 70s to a post anthropocene future, we follow in the footsteps of a mysterious creature with whom we journey across eras.
Directed by Benjamin Nuel, winner of the Best VR Story Award in Venice in 2018, AGE OF THE MONSTER is an interactive and dreamlike experience.

Agent Oops! is the cooperative Mixed Reality party game for 1-4 players that redefines how we play together! Collaborate with your friends to help Charles, the world’s clumsiest spy, by deactivating deadly traps, avoiding security cameras and using crazy spy tools. Featuring 11 worlds to explore, over 180 unique levels and the ability to create your own missions, Agent Oops! is a dynamic, chaotic, and social experience. Can you make the world believe that Charles is a true legend?
AI Conduct Lesson is a gaming experience for aspiring conductors.

AI Listener: Your Emotional Guide is your space to talk and be heard. Share your thoughts or worries with an AI that listens and responds naturally. A built-in journal reflects on past conversations, helping you look back and discover patterns. Meet characters like William Anderson or Sarah Mitchell, each bringing their own unique style.

Get ready for a thrilling VR adventure with Aim & Bounce! Use your skills to launch characters with precision, bouncing off obstacles and hitting colorful targets in vibrant, interactive worlds. Each level offers unique challenges requiring quick thinking and strategic timing. Perfect for casual gamers and VR enthusiasts, this action-packed game combines fun visuals with dynamic gameplay. Step into the action on Meta Quest and experience the excitement of aiming, launching, and bouncing your way

Aim Assault brings the thrill of old-school arcade rail-shooters into the world of virtual reality. Blast through various enemies, master different gunplay styles, and race the timer to climb to the top of the global leaderboards.

Try FREE DEMO https://www.meta.com/cs-cz/experiences/aim-assault-demo/9565626616867849/

Aim Reflex is a VR training game designed to sharpen your aiming reflexes. Use different weapons to shoot down robot and sphere targets, and track how fast you can eliminate 100 enemies. The built-in stat system records your performance, helping you improve reaction time and precision. Challenge yourself to beat your own scores, train smarter, and stay one step ahead of others in any VR game.
Get ready for an adrenaline-packed VR experience! Aim Shooting VR challenges your accuracy and reflexes in a thrilling, guided and immersive environment.

Step into Aim Trainer, a high-intensity shooter designed from the ground up to sharpen your reflexes and elevate your aim. Whether you're a casual player or a competitive sharpshooter, this fast-paced training ground offers a focused environment where every shot counts. Master precision, improve your reaction time, and dominate the leaderboard as you push your skills to the next level.

rows.source_name: Aim True - VR Archery Shooting Game
rows.parsed_name: Aim True - VR Archery Shooting Game

payload.description: Step into the world of archery like never before in Aim True. Test your precision, speed, and focus as you shoot targets, break records, and master the bow in a fully immersive VR experience.

Do you think you have a good aim? Prove it. AIMTROPOLIS is a VR arcade/shooter where you will have to prove yourself and the rest of the world in 7 random minigames from the 20 available. Get the highest score, and position yourself as a world champion.
Fast paced arcade jet fighting action! Unlock and fly some of the most fearsome aircraft of the sky.

Lock and load! Prepare for non-stop arcade shooting action in Air Cav! 

Take to the gunner seat of an attack helicopter and test your skills against enemy infantry, armored vehicles, and air units!

Air Cav is an arcade virtual reality shooting experience that places players in the role of a helicopter door gunner during intense combat scenarios!
The ultimate Air Hockey simulator

Airfight – Strike to the Beat, Sweat with Style
Airfight is an innovative fusion of VR immersion, rhythmic music, and boxing fitness. Players throw punches to the beat, burning calories in an energetic virtual world. A unique 3D trajectory system and scoring feedback enhance precision and interactivity, turning workouts into pure fun. Airfight breaks the boundary between gaming and fitness, creating a new form of immersive, healthy entertainment.

Take control of a high speed racing aircraft and compete across challenging aerial tracks built for virtual reality. Master sharp turns, alternate routes, timed boosts, and tactical dogfights as you race AI pilots in Championship, Arcade, and Time Trial modes. Win events, climb the local leaderboard, and unlock new aircraft, tracks, and rewards on your journey to become the champion of the Flight League.

This is an Early Access of a consumer version of the professional VR training software developed by AVIAR and used by the biggest airports and ground handlers to train their ground staff. Your role is a ground crew member and you will perform different tasks during an aircraft turnaround process at the airport.
Airport Idle에서 공항 관리자 역할을 맡아보세요! 터미널을 건설하고 항공 교통을 통제하며, 몰입감 있는 VR 세계에서 항공 일정을 관리하세요. 공항 제국을 성장시키고 새로운 항공기를 잠금 해제하며, 운영을 최적화하여 최대의 수익을 올리세요. 캐주얼 및 타이쿤 게임 팬에게 완벽한 게임!

This airport has rules. You have instincts. 🐾😈 Become a security dog in a chaotic VR experience—sniff luggage, chase distractions, and try (and fail) to follow the rules. You'll have more than 70 missions to clear with  laugh-out-loud chaos at every turn. ✈️🎒

Step into the role of an airport security officer in VR. Check passports, scan passengers, inspect luggage, monitor health vitals, and decide who is cleared to fly. Spot hidden threats, catch fake identities, and stop dangerous passengers in this intense VR security experience. Every decision matters.
Airspace Defender is a 3D tabletop arcade game in mixed reality. Manage your city's defenses and thwart enemy attacks with carefully timed retaliatory strikes!

A unique VR comedy from the creators of GARGOYLE DOYLE! Ajax (Henry Winkler) is a foul-mouthed genie addicted to the human souls he collects after tricking gullible masters. But something is different about the little girl who found his lamp this time: she's hired a lawyer (Chris Parnell) to negotiate her wishes.

Guide Albo and Alba through clever cooperative puzzles where every move matters. Navigate obstacles, master timing, and work together to reach the goal across handcrafted VR and mixed reality levels.

Early Access now available with 10 playable levels, with more puzzles, mechanics, and content coming in future updates.
Alien abduction is a game where you have a laser pistol to fight against the aliens who have invaded the Earth, you have to rescue 3 persons of your town that are being abducted on each mission.

Control an alien infested space station in this lighthearted VR strategy puzzle game. Guide Lenny the janitor through deadly and dangerous levels: sneak, burn, distract, pilot, blast and clean his way to safety. Control drones, check cameras and complete puzzles to solve the station's mysteries.

The aliens have landed! And they've taken over our houses, buildings, and monuments.
Well, if we can't have 'em, neither can they!
Use your trusty rocket launcher to destroy the buildings they're squatting in.
When they try and fly away in their UFOs, blow them out of the sky!
에이리언: 로그 인커전은 완전히 새로운 액션 호러 VR 게임으로, 전직 식민지 해병대원 Zula Hendricks가 되어 위험 천만한 임무를 맡고 미지의 행성 퍼단으로 떠납니다. 혁신적인 실제 모션을 활용한 게임플레이와 전신 장비, 지금까지 본 가장 교활한 제노모프를 만나보세요.

Aliens are hungry and they would LOVE to bite some tasty Beef.

Abduct the Beefs on each planet, while avoiding missiles, explosions and lasers. Indie Virtual Reality game using cool spherical gravity game mechanics.

Current episodes (6 levels on each):
- Episode 1 - Beef Regular
- Episode 2 - Beef Evolution (S/M/L/XL)
- Episode 3 - Beef in Chili Sauce
- Episode 4 - Beef BBQ

Leaderboards! (per episode + total score)

Blob Lab is a small single person indie game studio. Please support my work!
